summary: IEEE-library form of counter relay with electrical reset: an electrically reset counter relay has a separate reset command or documented electronic reset mechanism.
description: This reference locates counter relay with electrical reset in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented counter relays family. An electrically reset counter relay has a separate reset command or documented electronic reset mechanism. Schematics need the count and reset paths to remain distinct. The public library uses HCR1CNE for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Establish reset priority where count and reset signals can occur together. Electrical reset changes the counter state; it is not the same as disconnecting the measured circuit.
